about.what: A short, AI-written summary of today's dashboard data (markets, economy, rates, UK, sentiment, positioning) and clustered news headlines.
about.why: It turns dozens of panels into a two-minute read: what moved, what it may mean for the cycle, and which stories are driving it.
about.how_to_read: The pipeline builds a compact digest of the published numbers and asks a free LLM (Gemini, Groq as fallback) to narrate it. An automatic fact check then requires every number to match the digest exactly, with the right unit, the right direction (rose/fell) and the right metric (e.g. a number after 'core CPI' must be core CPI). It also rejects advice words (buy, sell, should…) and any regime name other than the computed one. A failing answer is sent back once with the errors, then the next provider is tried; if all fail, the previous summary is kept and marked stale. Treat it as a reading aid, not a forecast. Not investment advice.

brief.headline: S&P 500 gains 1.6% as AI optimism fuels rally
brief.what_moved: Equities advanced across major indexes, led by tech and AI stocks. Treasury yields edged higher, while volatility fell sharply. Commodities showed mixed performance with gold gaining and crude falling.
brief.cycle_view: The market sits at the Goldilocks boundary, with growth accelerating and inflation flat. Fed policy remains neutral, and duration‑leading credit signals a shift toward longer‑dated bonds. Commodities have historically been the strongest asset class in this phase.
